abstract: The first report of the familial testicular cancers in a father and his son in Japan was presented. The father had right testicular seminoma at 41 years of age and his son had right testicular embryonal cell carcinoma associated with teratoma elements at 17 years of age. To date only 30 pairs of testicular cancers occurring in father and son have been reported worldwide. Survey of the literature suggested that hereditary factors might be involved in the familial occurrence of testicular cancers although there was no definitive evidence.
abstract_ja: 日本で初めて報告された、父子における家族性精巣がんの症例である。父親は41歳時に右精巣セミノーマを、息子は17歳時に奇形腫成分を伴う右精巣胎児性癌を発症した。これまで世界で精巣がんの父子例は30組しか報告されていない。文献調査の結果、精巣がんの家族性発生には遺伝的要因が関与している可能性が示唆されたが、確定的な証拠は得られていない。
